mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declined over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, triggering risk-off flows that produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp m/m, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate housing sector contraction, signaling broader economic weakness that drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production growth (INDPRO > 1.5% q/q) indicates easing supply constraints, reducing inflation expectations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO growth exceeds 1.5% q/q, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting restrictive monetary policy that causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.5% y/y, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strong labor market conditions supporting corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days without thresholds.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS increased over prior 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Robust consumer spending (RSAFS growth > 0.8% m/m) indicates expanding aggregate demand, supporting corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS growth exceeds 0.8% m/m, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous Federal Funds rate above 3.0% and CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% y/y signals restrictive monetary policy amid high inflation, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 3.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0% y/y, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3 years.
